gloss: chestnut in its spiny husk; close-cropped (spiky) hair

definitions.explanation: A chestnut still enclosed in its prickly green outer burr ({毬|いが}). The fully ripe form that drops from the tree before being opened.
By metaphor, a very short hairstyle that resembles the bristly burr of a chestnut. Often used affectionately for young boys.

examples.japanese: {毬栗|いがぐり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちていた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: There was a spiny chestnut burr lying on the road.
When autumn comes, spiny chestnut burrs fall from the trees.
If you step on a spiny chestnut burr, the spines stick into your shoes and it hurts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{毬栗|いがぐり}{頭|あたま}にした。
examples.english: My younger brother got a buzz cut.

examples.japanese: {毬栗|いがぐり}{頭|あたま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男|おとこ}の{子|こ}→男の子：02862_otokonoko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{校門|こうもん}→校門：13116_koumon⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた。
examples.english: A boy with a buzz cut came out of the school gate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{野球部員|やきゅうぶいん}たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧{毬栗|いがぐり}{頭|あたま}にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The members of the baseball club all have buzz cuts.

notes:
Compound of {毬|いが} (the prickly burr of a chestnut) + {栗|ぐり} (chestnut). The hair-cut sense is always used with ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧ or {刈|か}り.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毬栗|いがぐり}{頭|あたま}: buzz cut (literally "chestnut-burr head")
- {毬栗|いがぐり}{刈|が}り: a close-cropped haircut
- {毬栗|いがぐり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: spiny chestnuts fall (from the tree)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{栗|くり}→栗：04387_kuri⟧: chestnut — the nut itself, without the burr
- {坊主頭|ぼうずあたま}: shaved head — even shorter than {毬栗|いがぐり}{頭|あたま}
